register.labelZh: STOP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: stop around、stop by 和 stop back 能幫助你分辨逗留一會、短暫探訪和稍後返回。；stop in、stop behind、stop on、stop out 和 stop up 可以分別描述留在家中、其他人離開後留下、延長工作時間、在外逗留至很晚和熬夜。；stop off 表示繼續行程前短暫停留;stop over 通常表示途中停留過夜。；stop away 可以描述不出席活動;stop something up 則可以描述填塞洞口或縫隙。
register.summaryEn: Stop around, stop by and stop back help you distinguish between visiting for a while, making a brief visit and returning later. Stop in, stop behind, stop on, stop out and stop up describe staying at home, remaining after others leave, working longer, staying away from home late and staying awake late. Stop off describes a short break before continuing a journey, while stop over usually describes an overnight stay. Stop away can describe not attending an event, while stop something up can describe filling a hole or gap.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Stop off means taking a short break during a journey. Stop over usually means staying for a night during a journey. Stop up can mean staying awake late. Stop something up means filling or blocking an opening. With it or them, say stop it up or stop them up.
